text_block_list.text:
When training with Nakayama Festa had come 
to an end—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Good work. Go ahead and head out before 
me.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"I'm tired, but somehow... I also feel 
like I haven't run enough."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
So, I'm going to leave whether I run an 
extra race or not to a coin toss.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heads, I run a bit more. Tails, I call it 
a day quietly.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hup... Now, which one could it be?
choice_data_list: If you end up running, I'll join you.

Even if it comes up heads, it's a 
no—you'll end up overrunning.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...It's not like you're free either. You 
really are a glutton for punishment.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
choice_data_list: Alright, let's push for one more!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Why are you all fired up too?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Oh well, lady luck is smiling on my 
running. Then all that's left is to train 
hard... Here I go!"

And so, I did some extra training 
alongside Nakayama Festa.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hey, the die has already been cast, hasn't 
it? Regardless of the outcome, telling 
someone not to run just isn't right.
choice_data_list:
I don't want to leave managing my health 
up to a gamble.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Either way, it's tails, so no running. 
You've got some pretty good luck when it 
counts.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Since we're here, how about one more 
match? The loser buys the juice!"

Afterward, I ended up treating Nakayama 
Festa to juice, but we managed to prevent 
any overwork before it could happen.
